defects.reason: The current DailyMed full prescribing information for LEQVIO displays 'Revised: 2/2026'. The 20260819 date visible in the current SPL belongs to the updated Indications and Usage section/publication activity and is not the full prescribing-information revision date.
defects.verified_locator: Highlights: Revised 2/2026; Section 12.1 Mechanism of Action

defects.replacement: Live DailyMed label checked 2026-09-07. The full prescribing information displays Revised: 2/2026. The current SPL also contains later section/publication activity (including an Indications and Usage section date of 20260819); that later date must not be represented as the full PI revision date.

items.verified_mechanism: Inclisiran is a GalNAc-conjugated double-stranded siRNA that directs RNA-interference-mediated catalytic breakdown of PCSK9 mRNA in hepatocytes, increasing LDL-receptor recycling/expression and LDL-C uptake.

primary_source_check.title: Inclisiran in Patients at High Cardiovascular Risk with Elevated LDL Cholesterol

items.verified_mechanism: Mavacamten is a selective allosteric reversible cardiac-myosin inhibitor that reduces the number of myosin heads entering force-generating actin states and shifts myosin toward the super-relaxed state.

primary_source_check.title: Mavacamten stabilizes an autoinhibited state of two-headed cardiac myosin

items.verified_mechanism: Belzutifan binds HIF-2alpha and blocks HIF-2alpha/HIF-1beta interaction, reducing transcription of HIF-2alpha target genes without requiring restoration of VHL or degradation of HIF-2alpha protein.

primary_source_check.title: Inhibition of hypoxia-inducible factor-2alpha in renal cell carcinoma with belzutifan: a phase 1 trial and biomarker analysis

items.verified_locator: 12.1 Mechanism of Action; persistent suppressed ADAMTS13 language in dosing/clinical-study sections
items.verified_mechanism: Caplacizumab targets the A1 domain of von Willebrand factor and inhibits vWF-platelet interaction, reducing vWF-mediated platelet adhesion and platelet consumption while the underlying ADAMTS13 autoimmune defect can remain active.

primary_source_check.title: Caplacizumab Treatment for Acquired Thrombotic Thrombocytopenic Purpura

items.verified_mechanism: Maribavir competitively inhibits CMV pUL97 protein kinase. pUL97 is required for activation/phosphorylation of ganciclovir/valganciclovir, while maribavir itself does not directly inhibit CMV DNA polymerase in the cited biochemical assay.

blueprint_check.note: The listed organ-system categories and Medical Knowledge: Applying Foundational Science Concepts competency are current Step 1 specification categories.

format_check.note: Current USMLE guidance describes a patient-centered vignette followed by four or more response options; five A-E options are valid and are not a defect.
